shots.focal_element: Custom Fields block of a task, with glowing outlines on the 'From Account type' and 'From location' group labels
shots.typography: No overlay type; native product UI text only (sans-serif, medium-weight 'Custom Fields' section header, regular sentence-case field labels). Group labels get a soft gradient glow outline as the only added graphic.
shots.what_happens: Tight crop on a task's Custom Fields while VO says 'custom field task types' (w194-w210); two group labels light up with glowing outlines, then the cursor opens the Account Tier dropdown and switches Gold to Bronze before hovering Department.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a cropped task-detail panel at ~150% scale, draw animated gradient-stroke rounded rectangles around the two field-group labels, then script a cursor that opens a select menu and picks a new option chip.

shots.focal_element: Full ClickUp task window ('NovaCore Solutions') floating on a grainy magenta-orange-blue gradient
shots.typography: Native UI only: bold sentence-case task title, regular sans-serif list rows; a playful in-task image caption 'No spillover here!' in bold with emoji.
shots.what_happens: Camera pulls out from the field close-up to reveal the whole app window with drop shadow on a gradient backdrop; the window scrolls to Subtasks, the cursor opens 'Review account details', which shows a meme image, then the frame whites out into a soft blur at the end (VO w210-w220 'cleaner, sharper, built exactly for the work at hand').
shots.build_rebuild: Place an app-window screenshot with large soft drop shadow over an animated grainy gradient, scale it from 1.6 to 1.0, scroll the inner content, cut its content to a subtask view on click, and end with a white blur-out.

shots.composition_other: diagonal: tilted 3D UI plane running top-right to bottom-left, profile card left of centre
shots.focal_element: Perspective-tilted ClickUp sidebar and Home menu with a 'Project Manager' profile card in front
shots.typography: Native UI type in a clean sans-serif, laid flat on a tilted plane; no overlay headline. Most text is defocused and unreadable.
shots.what_happens: Out of the white blur, a tilted 3D layout of UI fragments (sidebar, Home menu, task list, a profile card) racks into focus then softens again, as VO starts 'And we've built all of this' (w221-w226).
shots.build_rebuild: Compose flat UI fragments on a single plane, rotate it in 3D (about rotateX 45deg, rotateZ -30deg) under a slow camera drift, and animate a depth-of-field blur from strong to sharp and back over 1.7 s.

shots.focal_element: Single floating feature card (Chat, then Calendar, then Teams Hub) on a grainy purple-pink gradient
shots.transition_other: unseen hand-off from the white tilted UI to the gradient card stage; likely a motion-blurred card swap
shots.typography: Card titles in bold sentence-case sans-serif with a coloured product icon; small regular sans body text inside each card.
shots.what_happens: Rounded feature cards fly through centre frame one after another with heavy motion blur, each briefly settling (Chat, Calendar, Teams Hub) as the VO says 'the quality and craft' (w227-w231), recapping features shown earlier.
shots.build_rebuild: Stack simplified feature-card components and fly each through centre in turn with a vertical slide plus directional motion blur, holding each card about 0.5 s on an animated grain gradient.

shots.composition_other: UI plane tilted into the lower-right of frame with a callout label upper-left
shots.focal_element: Kinetic callout label 'pixel precision' with a dotted leader line pointing to the corner of a tilted app window
shots.typography: Large lowercase geometric sans-serif, 'pixel' in a lighter weight and 'precision' in bold, white on the gradient, tight tracking; connected by a dotted leader line.
shots.what_happens: Remaining cards (incl. Brain) whip past with motion blur, then a tilted app window settles in from below and a 'pixel precision' annotation appears with a leader line to the window corner, landing on 'ClickUp. Every pixel' (w236-w238).
shots.build_rebuild: Whip the previous cards off-frame with vertical motion blur, slide a 3D-tilted window screenshot up into the lower-right, then draw a dotted leader line and fade in a two-weight lowercase label at its end.

shots.focal_element: Stack of feature cards dropping onto a pile that resolves into a single card bearing the ClickUp logo
shots.what_happens: On a soft lavender-white floor, feature cards (Teams Hub, Sprints and others) drop from above with motion blur and stack into a neat pile with coloured edges, which compresses into one white card showing the ClickUp logo, under VO 'refined, every workflow smoother' (w239-w242).
shots.build_rebuild: In a 3D scene with an overhead camera, drop card meshes one at a time onto a stack with eased landings and soft contact shadows, then collapse the stack into a single card textured with the logo.
